summary: The Black Saint and the Sinner Lady is a 1963 studio album by American jazz musician Charles Mingus, released on Impulse! Records. It consists of a single continuous composition that was partially written as a ballet. The work is divided into four tracks and six movements.
one_line: A 1963 Charles Mingus studio album on Impulse! Records, built from one continuous composition partly written as a ballet.
key_facts: The Black Saint and the Sinner Lady is a studio album by American jazz musician Charles Mingus.

The composition was partially written as a ballet.
The composition is divided into four tracks.
The composition is divided into six movements.
